svg.title: Match the split to the prediction task
svg.desc: Panel A holds out scattered cases from the same population, for example using a random or stratified split when cases are exchangeable. The cases have no time order. Panel B fits weights using earlier observations and predicts later values, with all held-out values to the right of the cutoff. Blue means use for fitting; orange means hold out for evaluation. These are illustrative model-selection splits; a separate final test set is not depicted.
